finding.explanation: The commit made the benchmark slower because it changed the way reverse links are chosen. In the new version, it re-selects the neighbors to ensure that the links stay diverse, which can lead to slower search times. The old version simply appended the new node to the existing links, which may not be optimal for maintaining diversity.
